title: Pilau and Biryani: The Spice Dishes of the Coast
excerpt: Pilau and biryani are the spiced rice dishes of the Swahili coast, shaped by centuries of trade with India and Arabia.
body:
## Pilau

Rice cooked with spices such as cumin, cardamom, cinnamon, cloves and black pepper, often with meat. A festive dish.

## Biryani

Rice and a spiced meat or fish sauce, often served separately on Zanzibar.

## History

Indian Ocean trade brought spices and recipes. See [Zanzibar's history](/blog/zanzibar-history-swahili-coast/).

## Other coastal dishes

- Coconut fish curry
- Mchuzi wa samaki (fish in sauce)
- Urojo
- Mandazi

## Learn

Take a [Swahili cooking class](/blog/zanzibar-cooking-class/).
